description: This file contains unit tests for the FineractRemoteJobMessageHandlerCondition class, which determines whether certain messaging conditions are met based on environment properties in the Fineract project.

classes.name: FineractRemoteJobMessageHandlerConditionTest
classes.description: Test class for the FineractRemoteJobMessageHandlerCondition's behavior under various environment configurations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the mock environment and sets up the condition context for testing.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnFalseWhenSpringEventsIsEnabledAndManagerAndWorker
methods.description: Verifies that the condition does not match when both batch manager and worker are enabled with spring events enabled.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnTrueWhenSpringEventsIsEnabledAndManagerOnly
methods.description: Verifies that the condition matches when only batch manager is enabled with spring events enabled.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnTrueWhenSpringEventsIsEnabledAndWorkerOnly
methods.description: Verifies that the condition matches when only batch worker is enabled with spring events enabled.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnFalseWhenJmsIsEnabledAndManagerAndWorker
methods.description: Verifies that the condition does not match when both batch manager and worker are enabled with JMS enabled.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnFalseWhenJmsIsEnabledAndManagerOnly
methods.description: Verifies that the condition does not match when only batch manager is enabled with JMS enabled.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnFalseWhenJmsIsEnabledAndWorkerOnly
methods.description: Verifies that the condition does not match when only batch worker is enabled with JMS enabled.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnTrueWhenSpringEventsIsEnabledAndJmsIsEnabled
methods.description: Verifies that the condition matches when both spring events and JMS are enabled, along with both batch manager and worker being enabled.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnFalseWhenNoMessagingIsConfiguredAndNotManagerOrWorker
methods.description: Verifies that the condition does not match when messaging is disabled and neither manager nor worker is enabled.
